title: Year 11 Physics Module 3 – Waves and Thermodynamics
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Physics Module 3. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What do waves transfer from one place to another without transferring matter overall?
What is the maximum displacement of a wave from its equilibrium position called?
What is the distance between two consecutive points in phase, such as crest to crest?
What quantity measures the number of wave cycles passing a point each second?
What is the time taken for one complete wave cycle called?
What wave behaviour occurs when a wave bounces from a surface?
What wave behaviour occurs when a wave changes direction as its speed changes between media?
What wave behaviour causes waves to spread around obstacles or through gaps?
What principle describes waves combining when they overlap?
What phenomenon occurs when overlapping waves combine to produce a new pattern?
Is sound a mechanical wave or an electromagnetic wave?
Does light require a material medium to travel?
In air, is sound mainly longitudinal or transverse?
What property of a sound wave mainly determines its pitch?
What property of a sound wave is related to its loudness?
What type of heat transfer occurs through direct particle interactions within a material?
What type of heat transfer occurs through the bulk movement of a fluid?
What type of heat transfer can occur through a vacuum?
Thermal energy naturally transfers from a hotter object to an object at what relative temperature?
What state is reached when two objects in contact have the same temperature and no net heat transfer occurs?
What quantity describes how hot or cold an object is?
What term describes energy transferred because of a temperature difference?
What microscopic motion generally increases when the temperature of a substance rises?
questions.answer: Particle motion. Accept: average kinetic energy of particles.
